title: Budget Allocation — Mid-Crisis Review
description: With Tyvaren escalating and Dravenhollow in flux, review your budget priorities before the situation constrains your options further.

title: Dravenni — Autonomy Framework Negotiation
description: Idris Kaelen has sent a formal autonomy proposal through the Dravenni deputies. Eleven pages. Specific. It asks for things the current constitution doesn't allow — and things the next one might have to.

title: Border Incidents — Rules of Engagement
description: The skirmishes haven't stopped. Two Veltrian soldiers wounded this week. The general staff is pressing for more flexible rules of engagement. Dusek wants your decision before someone else makes it for you.

title: Inner Circle — Loyalty Reassessment
description: The betrayals of week 30 are still being felt. Some positions have been filled. Some haven't. The empty chairs at the cabinet table are a message. Make sure the remaining ones are sending the right one.

title: Nadia Voss — Investigation Status
description: Danika reports that Nadia Voss has filed additional records requests. She's building something — a full investigation, not just a story. Whatever she publishes will land with the weight of documented truth.
